Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are already out in the middle now. However, Smriti Mandhana has not taken the field for the moment. Amy Jones and Tammy Beaumont are the two openers for England Women. Kranti Gaud to start proceedings with the ball. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

England Women now face a stiff challenge to overcome the mammoth total. India's batting lineup delivered an outstanding performance, with Harmanpreet Kaur's century setting the tone for a strong finish. The hosts will need to devise a solid strategy to restrict India's momentum and achieve the target. The stage is set for an exciting contest at the Riverside Ground in Durham. Stay tuned for the chase...

The partnership between Harmanpreet Kaur and Jemimah Rodrigues was instrumental in India's strong finish. They added 110 runs in just 69 balls, with Kaur scoring 102 off 84 balls and Rodrigues scoring 50. After Rodrigues' dismissal, Richa Ghosh's cameo of 38 off 18 balls helped India reach a formidable total. England Women will have a monumental task ahead of them to chase down this target. Each of England's five bowlers took a wicket, but they were expensive, with only Sophie Ecclestone bowling economically. The others struggled to contain India's scoring.

A batting masterclass from the India Women as they end up with a mammoth 318 on the board and all thanks to Harmanpreet Kaur's brilliant century. The Indian skipper was ably supported by Smriti Mandhana, who scored 45, and Harleen Deol, who fell five runs short of her fifty. Jemimah Rodrigues also played a crucial role, scoring a fifty and adding 110 runs with Kaur for the fourth wicket.
Much fuller, on middle and leg, Richa Ghosh lofts it over mid on for two more. India Women end their innings at 318/5!
